title: Start
body:
*KNOCK KNOCK KNOCK*
That must be them! Fiddlesticks, where did she put the keys?
I don’t have time for this, I’ll just use what’s around me. Surely there’s a lockpick potion in her witch’s book.
I can switch between the storefront and the lab by clicking the arrow in the corner.
*KNOCK KNOCK KNOCK*
Please wait just a moment!
